title: Astrid and the Compass
author: Gideon Galloway
blurb: Jude Fairweather, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
